hakurikijwe aya Masezerano, guhera igihe
impamyabuvumbuzi yatangiwe no mu gihe
gisigaye cyayo, bibazwe guhera ku itariki y`itangwa
ry`ubusabe hagendewe ku ngingo ya 33 y'aya
Masezerano, ku busabe muri ubwo bwujuje
ibikurikizwa mu kurengera bivugwa mu gaka ka
(b).
9. Iyo icyakozwe gisabirwa impamyabuvumbuzi
mu kindi Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
hagendewe ku gika cya 8(a), hatangwa
uburenganzira rukumbi bwo kwamamaza
ubucuruzi, hatitawe ku biteganywa n'igice cya VI,
mu gihe cy'imyaka itanu nyuma yo kwemererwa
kwamamaza ubucuruzi muri icyo Gihugu cyangwa
kugeza igihe impamyabuvumbuzi kuri icyo
cyakozwe itangiwe cyangwa yangiwe gutangwa
muri icyo Gihugu, igihe kigufi kurushaho kikaba ari
cyo cyitaweho , ariko ari uko gusa, nyuma y’uko
Amasezerano y'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga
w'Ubucuruzi atangiye gukurikizwa, ubusabe bwo
buhabwa impamyabuvumbuzi bwatanzwe kandi
impamyabuvumbuzi na yo ikaba yaratangiwe icyo
cyakozwe mu kindi Gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano ndetse hakaba harabayeho
kwemererwa kwamamaza muri icyo Gihugu kindi.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu gukoresha ikirango cy`uruganda 1. Iyo hasabwa gukoresha ikirango cy’uruganda kugira
articles.text:
ngo iyandikwa rigumeho, iyandikwa rishobora gusibwa
gusa nyuma y'igihe nibura cy'imyaka itatu idahagaze
kidakoreshwa, cyeretse igihe nyir’ikirango agaragaje
impamvu zumvikana zishingiye ku ntambamyi
zabangamiye iryo koreshwa. Impamvu zibayeho
zidaturutse ku bushake bwa nyir’ikirango cy’uruganda
kandi zikaba zarabaye intambamyi z'ikoreshwa ryacyo,
zirimo ikumira ryo gutumiza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga
cyangwa ibindi bisabwa na Leta ku bicuruzwa no kuri
serivisi zirengerwa n'ikirango cy’uruganda, zifatwa
nk'impamvu zumvikana zo kudakoreshwa.
2. Iyo hagendewe ku bugenzuzi bwa nyira cyo,
ikoreshwa n'undi muntu ry`ikirango cy`uruganda
rifatwa nko kugikoresha kugira ngo iyandikwa
rigumeho.

articles.heading: Ibindi bisabwa Ikoreshwa ry'ikirango cy`uruganda mu bucuruzi ntiribangamirwa ku buryo budasobanutse n'ibisabwa
articles.text:
byihariye, nk'ikoreshwa ry`ikindi kirango cy`uruganda,
ikoreshwa mu buryo bwihariye cyangwa bwangiza
ubushobozi bwacyo mu gutandukanya ibicuruzwa na
serivisi z'uruganda rumwe n'iz`izindi nganda. Ibi
ntibikuraho amabwiriza ategeka ikoreshwa ry’ikirango
cy`uruganda kigaragaza uruganda rwakoze ibicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi icyarimwe, ariko hatabayeho
kubihuza, hamwe n’ikirango cy`uruganda gitandukanya
ibyo bicuruzwa byihariye cyangwa izo serivisi zihariye
by`urwo ruganda.

articles.heading: Gutanga impushya no kwegurira undi ibirango by`inganda Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
articles.text:
gushyiraho ibisabwa mu gutanga impushya no mu
kwegurira undi ibirango by`inganda, byumvikana ko
gutanga impushya z'ibirango by`inganda bitegetswe
bitemewe kandi ko nyir`ikirango cy`uruganda cyanditse
afite uburenganzira bwo kucyegurira undi bitabaye
ngombwa ihererekanya ry`uruganda icyo kirango
kigaragaza.
ICYICIRO CYA 3: IBIMENYETSO
NDANGAHANTU

articles.heading: Ukurengera Ibimenyetso Ndangahantu 1. Muri aya Masezerano, ibimenyetso ndangahantu ni ibimenyetso bigaragaza igicuruzwa nk'igikomoka ku
articles.text:
butaka bw'Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano, cyangwa
k`ubw`akarere cyangwa se k`ubw`agace k`ubwo butaka,
aho ubutajorwa bw`icyo gicuruzwa, uko gifatwa
cyangwa se ibindi bikiranga bishingiye kuri aho hantu
gikomoka.
2. Ku bijyanye n`ibimenyetso ndangahantu, Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biteganya uburyo
bw'amategeko ku mpande zibifitemo inyungu mu
kwirinda:
a) ikoreshwa ry`uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose mu kwita
cyangwa mu kumurika igicuruzwa, bwerekana cyangwa
busaba ko icyo gicuruzwa gikomoka ahantu hatari aho
gikomoka h'ukuri mu buryo buyobya rubanda ku
bijyanye n`ahantu gikomoka;
b) ikoreshwa iryo ari ryo ryose ry'igikorwa cy'ipiganwa
ritanyuze mu mucyo mu bisobanuro by'ingingo ya 10 bis
yo mu Masezerano y`i Parisi (1967).
3. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyemera cyangwa
kigatesha agaciro, nta mpaka, iyo amategeko yacyo
abyemera cyangwa bisabwe n'uruhande rubifitemo
inyungu, iyandikwa ry'ikirango cy`uruganda
kibumbatiye cyangwa kigize ikimenyetso ndangahantu
cy'ibicuruzwa bidakomoka ku butaka bwagaragajwe,
iyo imikoreshereze y'icyo kimenyetso ku kirango
cy'uruganda kuri ibyo bicuruzwa muri icyo Gihugu
kiyobya rubanda ku byerekeranye n'aho gikomoka.
4. Kurengera guteganywa mu gika cya mbere, mu cya
2 no mu cya 3 gukurikizwa ku kimenyetso ndangahantu,
n`ubwo cyaba cyanditswe mu buryo bugaragara ko ari
icyo ku butaka bw`Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano,
icyo mu karere cyangwa icyo mu gace k’Igihugu
ibicuruzwa bikomokamo, gituma rubanda batekereza ku
buryo butari ubw`ukuri ko ibicuruzwa bikomoka ku
butaka bw`ikindi Gihugu.

articles.heading: Ibiteganywa mu gika cya 4 n`icya 8 hepfo, ntibikoreshwa n'Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kugira ngo cyange gukora imishyikirano cyangwa
articles.text:
kugirana amasezerano hagati y'Ibihugu bibiri cyangwa
Ibihugu byinshi.
Ku bijyanye n`iyi mishyikirano, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano biba byiteguye gusuzuma ikurikizwa
rikomeza ry'ibyo biteganywa ku bimenyetso
ndangahantu byihariye aho ikoreshwa ryabyo ari ryo
ryari rigenderewe muri iyi mishyikirano.
2. Inama y’Ubucuruzi bujyanye n'uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge ikomeza gusuzuma
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'ibiteganywa muri iki Cyiciro;
ikora isuzuma rya mbere mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri
uhereye igihe Amasezerano y'Umuryango
Mpuzamahanga w'Ubucuruzi yatangiriye gukurikizwa.
Ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose kijyanye n’iyubahirizwa
ry'inshingano zikomoka kuri ibyo biteganywa muri iki
Cyiciro Inama ishobora gushyikirizwa, bisabwe na
kimwe mu Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, Inama
ikigishaho inama Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
cyangwa Ibihugu biyahuriyeho, igihe byananiranye
kubonerwa igisubizo kirambye biciye mu bujyanama
bw’Ibihugu bibiri cyangwa byinshi birebwa na cyo.
Inama ikora icyo gikorwa nk'uko bishobora
kwemeranywaho mu rwego rwo korohereza ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry’iki Cyiciro ndetse n'iry`izindi ntego
zacyo.
3. Mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibikubiye muri iki Cyiciro,
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano ntikigabanya
irengerwa ry`ibimenyetso ndangahantu ryari risanzweho
muri icyo Gihugu ako kanya mbere y'itariki
Amasezerano y'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga
w'Ubucuruzi yatangiriye gukurikizwa.
4. Nta na kimwe mu biteganywa muri iki Cyiciro gisaba
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gukumira ikoreshwa
rikomeza cyangwa risa ry'ikimenyetso ndangahantu
cyihariye cy'ikindi Gihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano kigaragaza divayi cyangwa inzoga zo mu
bwoko bw'ibyotsi gifitanye isano n'ibicuruzwa cyangwa
na serivisi bikozwe n`uwo ari we wese mu banyagihugu
b`icyo Gihugu cyangwa n`abatuye ku butaka bwacyo
bakoresheje icyo kimenyetso ndangahantu mu buryo
bukomeza ku bijyanye n'ibicuruzwa cyangwa na serivisi
bisa cyangwa bifitanye isano ku butaka bw'icyo Gihugu
yaba (a) mu gihe nibura cy'imyaka 10 ibanziriza itariki
ya 15 Mata 1994, cyangwa (b) nta buriganya mbere
y`iyo tariki.
5. Igihe ikirango cy'uruganda cyakoreshejwe cyangwa
cyanditswe nta buriganya, cyangwa se iyo
uburenganzira kuri cyo bwatanzwe nta buriganya:
a) mbere y'itariki y'ikurikizwa ry'izi ngingo kuri icyo
Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano nk'uko byasobanuwe
mu Gice cya VI; cyangwa
b) mbere y'uko ikimenyetso ndangahantu kirengerwa
mu Gihugu gikomokamo;
ingamba zafashwe mu gushyira mu bikorwa iki Cyiciro
ntizibangamira iyakira cyangwa agaciro k'iyandikishwa
ry'Ikirango cy'uruganda, cyangwa uburenganzira bwo
kugikoresha, hashingiwe ko icyo kirango gihwanye
cyangwa gisa n'ikimenyetso ndangahantu.
6. Nta na kimwe mu biteganywa muri iki Cyiciro gisaba
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gukurikiza
ibigiteganywamo ku bijyanye n'ikimenyetso
ndangahantu cy'ikindi Gihugu biyahuriyeho ku
bicuruzwa cyangwa kuri serivisi biriho ikimenyetso
gihuye n'imvugo imenyerewe mu rurimi nk'izina
rusange ry`ibyo bicuruzwa cyangwa ry`izo serivisi ku
butaka bw`icyo Gihugu. Nta na kimwe mu biteganywa
muri iki Cyiciro gisaba Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gukurikiza ibigiteganywamo bijyanye
n'ikimenyetso ndangahantu cy'ikindi Gihugu
biyahuriyeho ku bicuruzwa bya divayi biriho
ikimenyetso gihuye n'izina risanzwe rimenyerewe ku
butaka bw'icyo Gihugu ku itariki Amasezerano
y`Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w'Ubucuruzi yatangiriye
gukurikizwa.
7. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora
guteganya ko ubusabe bwose bukozwe hashingiwe kuri
iki Cyiciro bufitanye isano n'ikoreshwa cyangwa
n`iyandikwa ry'ikirango cy'uruganda butangwa mu
myaka itanu nyuma y`uko ikoreshwa ry'ikimenyetso
kirengewe ryamenyekanye muri rusange muri icyo
Gihugu cyangwa nyuma y'itariki y'iyandikisha
ry'ikirango cy`uruganda muri icyo Gihugu, icyo kirango
cy'uruganda gipfa gusa kuba cyaratangajwe kuri iyo
tariki, mu gihe iyo tariki ikoreshwa ry`ikirango
cy`uruganda rifite ibyo ryangiza ryamenyekaniyeho
muri rusange muri icyo Gihugu, ikimenyetso
ndangahantu gipfa gusa kudakoreshwa cyangwa ngo
cyandikwe mu buriganya.
8. Ibiteganywa muri iki Cyiciro ntacyo bibangamiraho
uburenganzira bw'umuntu wese bwo gukoresha, mu
bijyanye n'ubucuruzi, izina rye cyangwa se
iry'umuhagararira mu bucuruzi, keretse iyo iryo zina
rikoreshwa muri ubwo buryo mu kuyobya rubanda.
9. Nta nshingano ihari ishingiye kuri aya Masezerano yo
kurengera ibimenyetso ndangahantu bitarengerwa
cyangwa kurengerwa kwabyo kwarahagaze mu Gihugu
bikomokamo, cyangwa se bisigaye bitagikoreshwa muri
icyo Gihugu.
ICYICIRO CYA 4: IBISHUSHANYO CYANGWA
IBYITEGEREREZO BYO MU RWEGO
RW`INGANDA

articles.heading: Imishyikirano mpuzamahanga; Amarengayobora 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemeranya
articles.text:
gukora imishyikirano igamije kongera ukurengera
kw'ibimenyetso ndangahantu byihariye hakurikijwe

articles.heading: Ibisabwa kugira ngo habeho kurengera 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biteganya kurengera ibishushanyo cyangwa ibyitegererezo byo mu
articles.text:
rwego rw`inganda byahanzwe n'umuntu ku giti cye
byaba ibishya cyangwa iby'umwimerere.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
guteganya ko ibishushanyo cyangwa ibyitegererezo
bitari bishya cyangwa bitari iby'umwimerere iyo
bidatandukanye ku buryo bugaragara n'ibishushanyo
cyangwa n`ibyitegererezo bizwi cyangwa se
n`uruhurirane rw'ibigize ibishushanyo cyangwa
ibyitegererezo. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishobora guteganya ko uko kurengera kutazubahirizwa
ku bishushanyo no ku byitegererezo by’imikoreshereze
ya tekiniki.
2. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gikora ku
buryo ibisabwa mu kurengera ibishushanyo by'ubudozi,
by'umwihariko bifitanye isano n'ikiguzi icyo ari cyo
cyose, isuzumwa cyangwa itangaza, bitabangamira nta
mpamvu amahirwe yo gusaba n`ayo kubona uko
kurengera. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifite
ubwisanzure bwo kuzuza iyi nshingano binyuze mu
itegeko rigenga ibishushanyo byo mu rwego rw`inganda
cyangwa mu itegeko rirengera uburenganzira
bw'umuhanzi.

articles.heading: Ukurengera 1. Nyir`igishushanyo cyangwa nyir`icyitegererezo cyo mu rwego rw`inganda kirengewe afite uburenganzira
articles.text:
bwo kubuza abandi bantu badafite uburenganzira bwe,
gukora, kugurisha cyangwa gutumiza mu mahanga
ibicuruzwa biriho cyangwa bifite igishushanyo
cyangwa icyitegererezo cyo mu rwego rw`inganda
cyose uko cyakabaye cyangwa igice cy`ingenzi cyacyo
ari kopi y`icyo gishushanyo cyangwa y`icyo
cyitegererezo cyo mu rwego rw`inganda kirengewe
igihe ibyo bikorwa bikorwa ku mpamvu z'ubucuruzi.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biteganya
amarengayobora make yo kurengera ibishushanyo
n`ibyitegererezo byo mu rwego rw`inganda, ayo
marengayobora apfa kutabangamira nta mpamvu
ukubyaza umusaruro mu buryo busanzwe ibishushanyo
n`ibyitegererezo byo mu rwego rw`inganda ndetse no
kutabangamira inyungu zemewe n’amategeko za
nyirabyo, hitawe ku nyungu zemewe n`amategeko
z’abandi bantu.
3. Ukurengera kumara nibura igihe cy`imyaka 10.
ICYICIRO CYA 5: IMPAMYABUVUMBUZI

articles.heading: Ibitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi Haseguriwe ibivugwa mu gika cya 2 no mu cya 3, impamyabuvumbuzi ibonwa kuri buri gihangano
articles.text:
cy`ubuvumbuzi, yaba ibyakozwe cyangwa uburyo
bukoreshwa kugira ngo igikorwa runaka kigerweho,
icyo gihangano cy`ubuvumbuzi gipfa gusa kuba ari
gishya, kigaragaza igikorwa cyo kuvumbura kandi
gishobora gukoreshwa mu rwego rw`inganda.
Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu gika cya 4 cy'ingingo ya
65, mu gika cya 8 cy’ingingo ya 70 no mu gika cya 3
cy’iyi Ngingo, impamyabuvumbuzi zibonwa kandi
uburenganzira kuri zo bukubahirizwa nta vangura
rishingiye ku hantu igihangano cy`ubuvumbuzi
gikomoka, ku bijyanye n`ikoranabuhanga ndetse n`uko
ibyakozwe byatumijwe mu mahanga cyangwa
byarakorewe imbere mu Gihugu.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
kuvana mu bitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi, ibihangano
by`ubuvumbuzi aho ikumirwa ryo kubibyaza umusaruro
mu bucuruzi ari ngombwa ku butaka bw`ibyo Bihugu
hagamijwe kurengera ituze rusange rya rubanda
n’imigenzo myiza, harimo kurengera ubuzima
n`imibereho by`ikiremwamuntu, iby`inyamaswa
cyangwa iby’ibimera cyangwa kwirinda ukubangamira
gukomeye ibidukikije, iryo vanwaho ripfa kudakorwa
gusa kuko uko kubyaza umusaruro kubujijwe
n’amategeko y`ibyo Bihugu.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
kuvana mu bitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi:
a) uburyo bwo gusuzuma umubiri, ubwo kuvura n`ubwo
kubaga igihe bavura umuntu cyangwa inyamaswa;
b) ibimera n'inyamaswa bitari utunyabuzima n’uburyo
bwo kugera ahanini ku binyabuzima bugamije kubona
ibindi bimera cyangwa izindi nyamaswa butandukanye
n’uburyo butari ubwo kugera ku binyabuzima
n’utunyabuzima.
Icyakora, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
biteganya ukurengerwa n`impamyabuvumbuzi cyangwa
na gahunda yihariye cyangwa se n`uruhurirane rw`ibyo
byombi k'ubwoko butandukanye bwa buri kimera.
Ibivugwa muri iki gika byongera gusuzumwa nyuma
y`imyaka ine uhereye ku itariki Amasezerano
y'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w'Ubucuruzi yatangiriye
gukurikizwaho.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira butangwa 1. Impamyabuvumbuzi iha nyirayo uburenganzira bwihariye bukurikira
articles.text:
a) iyo igitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi ari icyakozwe,
kubuza abandi bantu batahawe uburenganzira na
nyiracyo gukora ibikorwa bikurikira: gukora icyakozwe,
kugikoresha, kugitanga ngo kigurishwe, kukigurisha,
cyangwa kugitumiza mu mahanga ku bw`izo mpamvu;
b) iyo igitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi ari uburyo
bukoreshwa kugira ngo igikorwa runaka kigerweho,
kubuza abandi bantu batahawe uburenganzira na
nyiracyo gukora igikorwa cyo gukoresha uburyo
bukoreshwa kugira ngo igikorwa runaka kigerweho
ndetse n'ibikorwa bikurikira: gukoresha, gutanga
hagamijwe igurisha, kugurisha, cyangwa gutumiza mu
mahanga ku bw`izo mpamvu, nibura icyakozwe
kiboneka mu buryo butaziguye hakoreshejwe ubwo
buryo.
2. Nyir`impamyabuvumbuzi kandi afite uburenganzira
bwo kwegurira cyangwa guha binyuze mu izungura,
impamyabuvumbuzi n`ubwo gukora amasezerano
yerekeye uruhushya.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa abasaba impamyabuvumbuzi 1.Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisaba ko usaba impamyabuvumbuzi yerekana ubuvumbuzi mu buryo
articles.text:
busobanutse bihagije kandi bwuzuye butuma
igihangano cy’ubuvumbuzi gikorwa n'umuntu ufite
ubumenyi muri uwo mwuga, ndetse bishobora gusaba
usaba impamyabuvumbuzi kugaragaza uburyo bwiza
kurusha ubundi bwo gukora igihangano cy’ubuvumbuzi
umuvumbuzi azi ku itariki y’itangwa ry’ubusabe
cyangwa, mu gihe hari usaba icyemezo cyo kuba
yaratanze abandi, ku itariki yo gusaba icyemezo cyo
kuba yaratanze abandi.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora gusaba
usaba impamyabuvumbuzi gutanga amakuru ku busabe
bijyanye yaba yaratanze hamwe n`impamyabuvumbuzi
zijyanye na bwo yaba yaraherewe mu mahanga.

articles.heading: Amarengayobora ku burenganzira butangwa Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora guteganya amarengayobora make ku burenganzira
articles.text:
bwihariye butangwa n'Impamyabuvumbuzi, ayo
marengayobora apfa gusa kutabangamira nta mpamvu
ukubyaza umusaruro impamyabuvumbuzi mu buryo
busanzwe ndetse no kutabangamira nta mpamvu
inyungu zemewe n`amategeko za
nyir`impamyabuvumbuzi, hitawe ku nyungu zemewe
n'amategeko z`abandi bantu.

articles.heading: Irindi koreshwa ridatangiwe uburenganzira na nyirabwo Iyo amategeko y`Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
yemera irindi koreshwa ry'ibitangirwa
impamyabuvumbuzi hadatanzwe uburenganzira na
nyirabwo, harimo ugukoreshwa n`inzego z`Igihugu
cyangwa n`abandi bantu babyemerewe na zo, ingingo
zikurikira zirubahirizwa:
a) uburenganzira butangwa kuri iryo koreshwa
busuzumwa hagendewe ku byo buri wese akwiye;
b) iryo koreshwa ryemerwa gusa iyo, mbere yaryo,
ugomba gukoresha ibitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi
yakoresheje uko ashoboye mu kubona uburenganzira
bwa nyir`uburenganzira, hakurikijwe amategeko
n’amabwiriza by’ubucuruzi byumvikana, ndetse kandi
ko izo mbaraga yakoresheje zitagize icyo zigeraho mu
gihe gikwiye. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kurenga kuri icyo gihe cyagenwe mu bihe
by`imidugararo ku rwego rw'Igihugu cyangwa mu bindi
bihe byihutirwa cyane cyangwa se bikoreshwa na
rubanda hatagamije ubucuruzi. Icyakora, mu gihe
byihutirwa ku rwego rw`Igihugu cyangwa mu bindi bihe
byihutirwa cyane, nyir`uburenganzira amenyeshwa
vuba bishoboka. Mu gihe bikoreshwa na rubanda
hatagamijwe ubucuruzi, iyo inzego z`Igihugu cyangwa
ufitanye amasezerano, hadakozwe ubushakashatsi ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi, bazi cyangwa bafite impamvu
zumvikana zo kumenya ko impamyabuvumbuzi igifite
agaciro ikoreshwa cyangwa izakoreshwa n'inzego
z`Igihugu cyangwa ikazakoreshwa ku mpamvu zazo,
nyir`uburenganzira amenyeshwa byihuse;
c) ibirebwa n`iryo koreshwa ndetse n`igihe rimara
bigarukira ku mpamvu zatumye ritangirwa
uburenganzira, kandi mu gihe cy'imiyoboro y'inzitane
mu by`ikoranabuhanga iryo koreshwa riba rigenewe
gusa ibikorwa rusange bitagamije ubucuruzi cyangwa se
kuzana igisubizo ku gikorwa cyemejwe, binyuze mu
miburanishirize y`imanza cyangwa mu mitunganyirize
y`ibibazo by`ubutegetsi, ko kibangamiye ipiganwa;
d) iryo koreshwa ntiriba umwihariko;
e) iryo koreshwa ntiryegurirwa undi muntu ridatangiwe
hamwe n'igice cy`ikigo cyangwa cy`umutungo
w’ubucuruzi iryo koreshwa rishingiyeho.
f) ikoreshwa iryo ari ryo ryose nk'iryo ryemerwa cyane
cyane ku itangwa ry'ibicuruzwa ku isoko ry'imbere mu
Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyemeye iryo
koreshwa;
g) uburenganzira kuri iryo koreshwa bushobora kongera
gutangwa, haseguriwe ko inyungu zemewe
n’amategeko z’abantu babyemerewe zirengerwa mu
buryo bukwiye, iyo kandi no mu gihe impamvu zatumye
bubaho zidakomeje kubaho ndetse bigaragara ko
zitazongera kubaho. Urwego rubifitiye ububasha rufite
ububasha bwo kongera gusuzuma, hagendewe ku
busabe bugaragaza ingingo bushingiyeho, niba izo
mpamvu zikomeje kubaho;
h) nyir`uburenganzira yishyurwa igihembo gikwiye kuri
buri gihe, hakurikijwe agaciro k'uburenganzira mu
rwego rw'ubukungu ;
i) igihe cyemewe n'amategeko cya buri cyemezo
cyerekeye uburenganzira bw'iryo koreshwa gishobora
gusubirwamo n'urukiko cyangwa n`urundi rwego
rwigenga rwisumbuye rwo muri icyo Gihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano;
j) buri cyemezo cyerekeye igihembo giteganyijwe mu
biijyanye n`iryo koreshwa gishobora gusubirwamo
n'urukiko cyangwa n`urundi rwego rwigenga
rwisumbuye rwo muri icyo Gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano;
k) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano ntibitegetswe
kubahiriza ibisabwa mu gaka ka (b) n`aka (f) iyo iryo
koreshwa ryemewe hagamijwe kuzana igisubizo ku
gikorwa cyemejwe binyuze mu miburanishirize
y`imanza cyangwa mu mitunganyirize y`ibibazo
by`ubutegetsi, ko kibangamiye ipiganwa. Ugushaka
gukosora ibikorwa bibangamiye ipiganwa bishobora
kwitabwaho mu kugena igihembo muri ibyo bihe.
Inzego zibifitiye ububasha zifite ububasha bwo kwanga
ko ubwo burenganzira burangira iyo ndetse no mu gihe
impamvu zatumye butangwa zishobora kongera kubaho;
l) iyo iryo koreshwa ryemewe hagamijwe kwemera
kubyaza umusaruro impamyabuvumbuzi
("impamyabuvumbuzi ya kabiri") idashobora kubyazwa
umusaruro hatabayeho kwigana indi
mpamyabuvumbuzi ("impamyabuvumbuzi ya mbere"),
ibisabwa by'inyongera bikurikira birakurikizwa:
i) ubuvumbuzi bwavuzwe mu mpamyabuvumbuzi ya
kabiri bugira uruhare mu iterambere rya tekiniki
ry’inyungu z’ubukungu zifatika, ugereranyije
n’ubuvumbuzi bwavuzwe mu mpamyabuvumbuzi ya
mbere;
ii) nyir`impamyabuvumbuzi agira uburenganzira ku
ruhushya magirirane mu buryo bwumvikana kugira ngo
akoreshe ubuvumbuzi buvugwa mu mpamyabuvumbuzi
ya kabiri, na
ii) ikoreshwa ryemewe mu bijyanye
n`impamyabuvumbuzi ya mbere ntiyegurirwa abandi
cyeretse iyo impamyabuvumbuzi ya kabiri na yo
yeguriwe abandi.

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa/Iyamburwa Kuri buri cyemezo kijyanye n`ihagarikwa cyangwa n`iyamburwa ry`impamyabuvumbuzi, habaho uburyo
articles.text: bwo kugisuzuma bikozwe n'urukiko.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo Kurengera Igihe cyo kurengera gitangwa ntikirangira mbere y'irangira ry'igihe cy'Imyaka 20 ibarwa uhereye ku
articles.text: itariki byasabiweho.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwakoreshejwe kugira ngo haboneke Impamyabuvumbuzi: ugomba kugaragaza ibimenyetso 1. Mu miburanishirize y`imanza z`imbonezamubano
articles.text:
zerekeye kubangamira uburenganzira bwa
nyir`impamyabuvumbuzi buvugwa mu gika cya 1 (b)
cy'Ingingo ya 28, iyo ibitangirwa impamyabuvumbuzi
ari uburyo bukoreshwa kugira ngo igikorwa runaka
kigerweho, inzego z'ubutabera zifite ububasha bwo
gutegeka uregwa kugaragaza ibimenyetso by`uko
uburyo bwakoreshejwe bwo kugera ku cyatunganyijwe
kimeze kimwe n`icyundi butandukanye n`uburyo
bwatangiwe impamyabuvumbuzi. Ku bw'ibyo, Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, nibura muri kimwe mu
bihe bikurikira, biteganya ko icyatunganyijwe cyose
bisa cyakozwe kimeze kimwe n`icyundi bitemewe na
nyir`impamyabuvumbuzi, kugeza igihe habonekeye
ingingo ibivuguruza, gifatwa nk`aho cyagezweho
hifashishijwe uburyo bwatangiwe impamyabuvumbuzi:
a) iyo icyatunganyijwe cyabonetse hakoreshejwe
uburyo bwatangiwe impamyabuvumbuzi ari gishya;
b) iyo bishoboka cyane ko icyatunganyijwe cyakozwe
hifashishijwe ubwo buryo kandi
nyir`impamyabuvumbuzi, nyuma yo kugerageza ku
buryo bwumvikana, atashoboye kugaragaza uburyo
nyakuri bwakoreshejwe ubwo ari bwo.
2. Igihugu cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano gifite
ubwisanzure mu guteganya ko ugomba kugaragaza
ibimenyetso uvugwa mu gika cya mbere ari uvugwa ko
yakoze icyaha iyo igisabwa kivugwa mu gaka (a)
cyujujwe cyangwa gusa igisabwa kivugwa mu gaka (b)
cyujujwe.
3. Mu gihe cyo kugaragaza ibimenyetso bivuguruza,
inyungu zemewe n`amategeko z’abaregwa mu kurinda
amabanga yabo yo gutuganyiriza ibintu mu nganda
n`ay`ubucuruzi zitabwaho.
ICYICIRO CYA 6: IBISHUSHANYO
NDANGAMITERERE (IMITERERE
Y’UBUTAKA) BY'URUSOBEKERANE
RW'IMIYOBORO YO MU RWEGO RWA
ELEGITORONIKI.

articles.heading: Ibyerekeye Amasezerano ya IPIC Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemera kurengera ibishushanyo ndangamiterere (imiterere
articles.text:
y’ubutaka) by'urusobekerane rw'imiyoboro (muri
aya Masezerano byitwa"ibishushanyo
ndangamiterere") hakurikijwe ingingo ya 2 kugeza
ku ya 7 (bitari igika cya 3 cy'ingingo ya 6), ingingo
ya 12 n'igika cya 3 cy'ingingo ya 16 y'Amasezerano
agenga umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge ku
bijyanye n’ibishushanyo ndangamiterere kandi
hubahirijwe ingingo zikurikira

articles.heading: Ibirebwa no kurengera umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge Haseguriwe ibiteganywa n'igika cya mbere
articles.text:
cy'ingingo ya 37, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bifata ibikorwa bikurikira
nk'ibitemewe n`amategeko iyo bikozwe nta
ruhushya rw’ufite uburenganzira: gutumiza mu
mahanga, kugurisha, cyangwa gukwirakwiza
hagamijwe ubucuruzi, igishushanyo
ndangamiterere kirengerwa, urusobekerane
rw'imiyoboro igishushanyo ndangamiterere
kirengerwa cyiyunzeho, cyangwa ingingo yunga
urwo rusobekerane rw'imiyoboro gusa igihe
rukomeje kugira igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cyatubuwe mu buryo bunyuranije n'amategeko.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa bidasaba uruhushya rw’ufite uburenganzira 1. Hatitawe ku ngingo ya 36, nta Gihugu kiri muri
articles.text:
aya Masezerano gifata nk'ibitemewe gukora
igikorwa cyose kivugwa muri iyo ngingo mu
bijyanye n`urusobekerane rw'imiyoboro rwunga
igishushanyo ndangamiterere cyatubuwe mu buryo
bunyuranije n'amategeko cyangwa ingingo yose
yunga urwo rusobekerane rw'imiyoboro aho
umuntu ukora cyangwa usaba ibyo bikorwa
atamenye cyangwa adafite impamvu zumvikana zo
kumenya, mu gihe cyo kwegukana urusobekerane
rw'imiyoboro, cyangwa ingingo yunga urwo
rusobekerane rw'imiyoboro, ko rwunga
igishushanyo ndangamiterere cyatubuwe mu buryo
bunyuranije n'amategeko.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biteganya ko,
nyuma y'igihe uwo muntu yaboneyeho imenyesha
mu buryo buhagije ko igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cyatubuwe mu buryo bunyuranyije n'amategeko,
uwo muntu ashobora gukora igikorwa cyose ku
bijyanye n’ububiko afite cyangwa yagisabye mbere
y'icyo gihe, ariko agomba kwishyura ufite
uburenganzira amafaranga angana nk’uko
cyakwishyurwa mu gihe habayeho ubwumvikane
butanga uburenganzira ku gishushanyo
ndangamiterere nk'icyo.
2. Ibisabwa bivugwa mu duka (a) kugeza kuri (k)
tw'ingingo ya 31 birakurikizwa hahindurwa
ibigomba guhindurwa mu byabaye byose by'utari
umukorerabushake ufite igishushanyo
ndangamiterere cyangwa imikoreshereze yacyo
bikoreshwa cyangwa bikorwa na Leta nta ruhushya
rw'ufite uburenganzira.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo kurengera umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge 1. Mu Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisaba
articles.text:
kwandikisha nk'igikurikizwa mu kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge, igihe cyo
kurengera ibishushanyo ndangamiterere
ntigishobora kurangira mbere y'uko igihe cy'imyaka
icumi, kibarwa kuva ku itariki yatangiweho
ubusabe bwo kwandikisha, kirangira cyangwa kuva
igihe ku bibyaza umusaruro bwa mbere mu
bucuruzi byabereye, aho byabereye hose ku isi.
2. Mu Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bidasaba kwandikisha nk'igikurikizwa mu
kurengera umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge,
igishushanyo ndangamiterere kirengerwa igihe
kitari munsi y'imyaka icumi kuva ku itariki ku
bibyaza umusaruro bwa mbere mu bucuruzi
byabereye, aho byabereye hose ku isi.
3. Hatitawe ku gika cya mbere no ku cya 2, Igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano giteganya ko kurengera
igihangano bimara imyaka 15 nyuma yo guhanga
igishushanyo ndangamiterere.
IGICE CYA 7:
KURENGERA AMAKURU ATASHYIZWE
AHAGARAGARA

articles.heading: 1. Mu rwego rwo guharanira ko habaho kurengera ku buryo bunoze mu kurwanya amarushanwa atanyuze mu mucyo nk'uko biteganywa mu ngingo
articles.text:
ya 10 bis y'Amasezerano y`i Parisi (1967), Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano birinda amakuru
atashyizwe ahagaragarara hagendewe ku gika cya 2
n'amakuru-shingiro yohererejwe Leta cyangwa
ibigo byayo hakurikijwe igika cya 3.
Abantu ku giti cyabo n’ibigo bifite ubuzima gatozi
bafite uburyo bwemewe n’amategeko bwo kurinda
ko amakuru bashinzwe yatangarizwa cyangwa
yahabwa abandi bantu cyangwa se ngo
bayakoreshe bitabyemeye ku bushake mu buryo
butandukanye n'imigirire nyakuri y'uburyo
bw’ubucuruzi, igihe cyose ayo makuru:
a. ari ibanga mu buryo, mu miterere cyangwa
guhuriza hamwe mu turango tw’ingenzi, rusange
bizwi cyangwa bigerwaho mu buryo bworoheye
abantu bari mu rwego rusanzwe rurebwa n'imiterere
y’amakuru avugwa;
b. afite agaciro k'ubucuruzi kubera ko ari ibanga;
kandi
c. afite impamvu zumvikana, bikozwe n'umuntu
ushinzwe amakuru mu buryo bwemewe
n'amategeko, zo kuyagira ibanga.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, iyo
bisaba, kugira ngo hemezwe iyamamaza ry'imiti
cyangwa ry`imiti ikoreshwa mu buhinzi ifite
ibinyabutabire bishya, kohereza igerageza
ritarashyirwa ahagaragara, cyangwa andi makurushingiro atarashyirwa ahagaragara, kandi kugira
ngo bigerweho bisaba imbaraga zo mu rwego rwo
hejuru, birinda ayo makuru ubucuruzi butemewe
n'amategeko.
Ikindi kandi, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
birinda amakuru shingiro nk'ayo kujya hanze,
cyeretse iyo ari ngombwa hagamijwe kurinda
rubanda, cyangwa hafashwe ibyemezo bigamije
gutuma ayo makuru arindwa kubyazwa umusaruro
mu bucuruzi butanyuze mu mucyo.
ICYICIRO CYA 8:
KUGENZURA IBIKORWA BY`IPIGANWA
BIRIMO UBURIGANYA MU BYEREKEYE
IMPUSHYA ZISHINGIYE KU
MASEZERANO

articles.heading: 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemera ko imigirire cyangwa ibikurikizwa bimwe na bimwe bijyanye no gutanga impushya zirebana
articles.text:
n’uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
bizitira ipiganwa bishobora kugira ingaruka ku
bucuruzi kandi bibangamira ihererekanya ndetse
n’ikwirakwizwa ry’ ikoranabuhanga.
2. Nta na kimwe muri aya Masezerano kibuza
Ibihugu biyahuriyeho kugaragaza mu mategeko
yabyo imigirire cyangwa ibikurikizwa mu gutanga
impushya mu bihe byihariye bishobora gutera
ikoreshwa nabi ry'uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite
mu by’ubwenge bibangamira ipiganwa kuri iryo
soko.
Nk'uko biteganywa haruguru, Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gishobora, bidahabanye n'izindi
ngingo zayo, gufata ingamba zikwiye zo gukumira
cyangwa izo kugenzura iyo migirire, ishobora
kubamo, nk`urugero, gusubiza impano, uburyo
bubuza guhakana agaciro n’uburyo bw’impushya
zitangwa ku gahato mu matsinda, hakurikijwe
amategeko n'amabwiriza biriho by'icyo Gihugu.
3. Buri Gihugu kiri muri Masezerano gishobora,
kibisabwe, kugisha inama ikindi Gihugu cyose
biyahuriyeho gifite impamvu zo kumva ko
nyir’uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge ari umwenegihugu cyangwa ari utuye
muri icyo Gihugu cyagishijwe inama gikora
ibinyuranye n’amategeko ndetse n'amabwiriza
y'Igihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano gisaba ku
bijyanye n'iki Cyiciro, kandi cyifuza kubahiriza ayo
mategeko, hatabangamiwe igikorwa cyose
hakurikijwe amategeko n’ubwisanzure busesuye
bwa buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano bwo
gufata icycmezo cya burundu.
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyasabwe
gisuzumana ubushishozi kandi ku buryo bwimbitse
ndetse kireba uburyo bukwiye cyajyamo inama
n'Igihugu biyahuriyeho cyasabye; bifatanya gitanga
amakuru atari ibanga kandi aboneka ajyanye
n'ikibazo cyigwaho n'andi makuru gifite,
haseguriwe amategeko y'imbere muri cyo ndetse
n`umwanzuro w'amasezerano yanyuze Ibihugu
byombi ku birebana no kurinda ibanga ryayo
bikozwe n'Igihugu cyasabye.
4. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano aho
abenegihugu bacyo cyangwa abagituyemo
bakurikiranwaho, mu kindi Gihugu biyahuriyeho,
ibyaha birebana no kurenga ku mategeko
n'amabwiriza y’icyo Gihugu kindi ku birebana n'iki
Cyiciro, iyo kibisabye, gihabwa amahirwe n`icyo
Gihugu kindi yo kugisha inama hakurikijwe
ibisabwa bisa n’ibiteganywa mu gika cya 3.
IGICE CYA III
IYUBAHIRIZWA RY’UBURENGANZIRA KU
MUTUNGO BWITE MU BY’UBWENGE
ICYICIRO CYA MBERE:
INSHINGANO RUSANGE

articles.heading: 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikora ku buryo amategeko yabyo abamo uburyo butuma
articles.text:
habaho iyubahirizwa ry`uburenganzira ku mutungo
bwite mu by`ubwenge nk’uko bugaragazwa muri
iki Gice, burimo ibyemezo bikosora byo gukumira
kutubahiriza ubwo burenganzira ndetse
n`ibyemezo bikosora byo gukumira abantu
kuzakora hanyuma ibikorwa byo kutabwubahiriza.
Ubwo buryo bukurikizwa mu rwego rwo kurwanya
imbogamizi ku bucuruzi bwemewe n`amategeko no
m`urwo gushyiraho ibirinda ikoreshwa nabi
ryabwo.
2. Uburyo bukurikizwa mu iyubahirizwa
ry'uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge bigomba kuba bunyuze mu mucyo
kandi butabogamye. Ntibugomba kuba bugoranye
mu buryo butari ngombwa cyangwa buhenze,
ntibugira igihe kirambirana cyangwa ngo butume
habaho gucyererwa nta mpamvu.
3. Ibyemezo mu mizi y`urubanza bigomba kuba
byanditse kandi bigaragaza impamvu.
Bigomba guhabwa nibura ababuranyi nta
gucyererwa nta mpamvu.
Ibyemezo mu mizi y`urubanza bigomba kuba
bishingiye gusa ku bimenyetso ababuranyi
baherewe uburenganzira bwo kumvwa.
4. Ababuranyi bafite amahirwe yo gusaba urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha gusuzuma ibyemezo bya nyuma
by`ubutegetsi ndetse, haseguriwe ingingo zitanga
ububasha ziteganywa n’amategeko y’Igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano ku birebana n’uburemere
bw’urubanza, no ku birebana byibuze n`amategeko
ku byemezo by`ibanze byafashwe n`inkiko mu
mizi.
Icyakora, nta nshingano yo guteganya amahirwe yo
gusaba kongera gusuzuma ibijyanye n'ifungurwa
mu manza nshinjabyaha.
5. Birumvikana ko iki Gice kidashyiraho
inshingano yo gushyiraho urwego rw'ubutabera
hagamijwe gushyira mu bikorwa uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge rutandukanye
n'urugenewe kubahiriza amategeko muri rusange,
cyangwa ngo gihungabanye ububasha bw'Ibihugu
biri muri aya Masezerano mu kubahiriza amategeko
yabyo muri rusange.
Nta kimwe mu biteganywa muri iki Gice gishyiraho
inshingano ku birebana no gusaranganya
ubushobozi hagati y'iyubahirizwa ry'uburenganzira
ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge n'iyubahirizwa
ry'amategeko muri rusange.
ICYICIRO CYA 2:
IMIBURANISHIRIZE Y`IMANZA
Z'IMBONEZAMUBANO N'IZ`UBUTEGETSI
N`IBYEMEZO BIKOSORA

articles.heading: Imanza zinyuze mu mucyo kandi zitabogamye
articles.text:
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishyiriraho
abafite uburenganzira imiburanishirize y’imanza
z`imbonezamubano zirebana n'iyubahirizwa
ry'uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge burebwa n'aya Masezerano.
Abaregwa bafite uburenganzira bwo kumenyeshwa
ku gihe mu nyandiko ifite ibisobanuro bihagije,
birimo n'ishingiro ry'ibirego.
Ababuranyi bemererwa guhagararirwa
n'abajyanama mu by'amategeko bigenga, kandi
iburanisha ntiritegeka ibisabwa biruhanyije
birebana no gutegeka ababuranyi kwitaba ubwabo.
Ababuranyi bose muri izo manza bafite
uburenganzira bwo gusobanura ibyo bavuga
n`ubwo kubitangira ibimenyetso byose bijyanye.
Urubanza ruteganya uburyo bwo kugaragaza
n`ubwo kurinda amakuru y'ibanga, usibye igihe
binyuranye n'ibyo itegeko-nshinga ririho riteganya.

articles.heading: Ibimenyetso 1. Inkiko zifite ububasha, aho ku mpamvu yumvikana umuburanyi watanze ibimenyetso byo
articles.text:
gushyigikira ibyo avuga kandi wagaragaje
ibimenyetso bihagije by`ibyo avuga bifitwe
n'umuburanyi bahanganye, gutegeka ko ibyo
bimenyetso bitangwa n'uwo muburanyi
bahanganye, haseguriwe ibisabwa, mu manza
zimwe na zimwe, bigamije kurinda amakuru
y'ibanga.
2. Iyo umuburanyi mu rubanza, yanze ku bushake
kandi nta mpamvu ifatika kugaragaza amakuru ya
ngombwa cyangwa kuyatanga mu gihe
kitarambiranye, cyangwa se abangamiye ku buryo
bugaragara urubanza rurebana n`ikirego cyatanzwe
mu rwego rwo kubahiriza uburenganzira, Igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora kwemerera
inzego z'ubutabera, gukora amahitamo y'ibanze
n'asoza, yemeza cyangwa ahakana, hagendewe ku
makuru zahawe, harimo ikirego cyangwa
ibyavuzwe n`umuburanyi wagizweho ingaruka no
kwanga gutanga amakuru, hagamijwe guha
ababuranyi uburyo bwo kumvwa ku bijyanye n'ibyo
bavuga cyangwa n`ibimenyetso.

articles.heading: Ibitegetswe 1. Inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gutegeka umuburanyi kwifata ku bijyanye no kubangamira
articles.text:
uburenganzira, cyane cyane kubuza kwinjira mu
bucuruzi mu bubasha bwazo w’ibicuruzwa
bitumijwe mu mahanga biteza kubangamira
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
nyuma yo gukura ibyo bicuruzwa muri gasutamo.
Ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano ntibitegetswe
gutanga ubwo burenganzira ku bijyanye
n'igikoresho kirengerwa cyabonywe cyangwa
cyasabwe n'umuntu mbere yo kumenya cyangwa
kugira impamvu zumvikana zo kumenya ko gukora
icyo gikorwa byatera kutubahiriza uburenganzira
ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge.
2. Haseguriwe ibiteganyijwe n'iki Gice kandi
hubahirijwe ibiteganywa mu gice cya II bijyanye
by'umwihariko no gukoreshwa na Leta cyangwa
n'abandi bantuyabyemereye, bidatangiwe
uburenganzira n'ufite uburenganzira, Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora kugabanya
ibyemezo bikosora bishoboka birwanya iryo
koreshwa ku kwishyura igihembo hakurikijwe
agaka (h) k'ingingo ya 31.
Mu bindi bihe, ibyemezo bikosora biteganywa n’iki
Gice birakurikizwa, cyangwa, aho ibyo byemezo
bitajyanye n’amategeko y'Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano, habaho imanza zemeza hagatangwa
n’indishyi zikwiye.

articles.heading: Indishyi z’akababaro 1. Inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gutegeka uwabangamiye uburenganzira kwishyura nyirabwo
articles.text:
indishyi z`akababaro zikwiye zihuye n'igihombo
yagize zikomotse ku kubangamira ubwo
burenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
bikozwe n`uwo muntu wabubangamiye abizi
cyangwa afite impamvu zumvikana zo kubimenya.
2. Inkiko zifite kandi ububasha bwo gutegeka
uwabangamiye uburenganzira kwishyura nyirabwo
ibyo yakoresheje bishobora kubamo amafaranga
akwiye y`umwavoka.
Aho biri ngombwa, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano byemerera inkiko gutegeka kwishyuza
inyungu n'indishyi z`akababaro cyangwa kimwe
muri byo zateganyijwe mbere kabone n'ubwo
uwabangamiye uburenganzira yabikoze atabizi,
cyangwa adafite impamvu zumvikana zo
kubimenya.

articles.heading: Ibindi byemezo bikosora Mu rwego rwo gushyiraho uburyo bwo gukumira ukutubahiriza uburenganzira, Inkiko zifite
articles.text:
ububasha bwo gutegeka ko ibicuruzwa zibonye ko
bitubahiriza uburenganzira, hatabayeho indishyi
z'uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose, bivanwa
y'ubucuruzi mu buryo bwo kwirinda kubangamira
nyir`uburenganzira cyangwa gutegeka, cyereste iyo
ibi binyuranyije n'ibyo itegeko-nshinga ririho
riteganya, ko bikurwaho.
Inzego z'ubutabera zifite kandi ububasha bwo
gutegeka ko ibikoresho n'ibyifashishwa
byakoreshejwe nk'iby'ibanze mu gukora ibyo
bicuruzwa byabangamiyeuburenganzira,
hatabayeho kwishyura indishyi mu buryo ubwo ari
bwo bwose, bivanwa mu bucuruzi mu buryo bwo
kugabanya ingaruka zo kutubahiriza ubwo
burenganzira bundi bushya.
Mu gihe cyo kwiga kuri ubwo busabe, ni ngombwa
kwita ku kujyanisha uburemere bwo kutubahiriza
uburenganzira n'ibyemezo bikosora byategetswe
ndetse n`inyungu z`abandi bantu batari ababuranyi.
Ku birebana n'ibicuruzwa bifite ibirango
by'ibyiganano, gukuraho ikirango cyashyizweho
mu buryo bunyuranyije n'amategeko byonyine
ntibihagije, uretse ku mpamvu zidasanzwe zo
gutuma ibicuruzwa byinjizwa mu bucuruzi.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo kubona amakuru Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora guteganya ko inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gutegeka,
articles.text:
usibye igihe icyo cyemezo kidahuye n'uburemere
bwo kubangamira uburenganzira, utubahirije
uburenganzira kumenyesha nyir`uburenganzira
amazina y`abandi bantu bafite uruhare mu kubyaza
umusaruro no mu gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa
cyangwa imirimo by`ibyiganano kimwe n'inzira
ibyo bicuruzwa n`iyo mirimo binyuramo.

articles.heading: Guha Uregwa indishyi 1. Inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gutegeka umuburanyi wasabye ko ibyemezo bifatirwa undi kandi akaba
articles.text:
yaratanze ikirego mu nzira z`uburiganya asaba
kurenganurwa mu bijyanye n'uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge, yishyura uwarezwe
arengana ko yakoze ibi n`ibi cyangwa atabikoze
indishyi ikwiranye n`akarengane yagiriwe kubera
icyo kirego cy`uburiganya.
Inkiko kandi zifite ububasha bwo gutegeka
uwareze kwishyura amafaranga agenerwa uregwa
habariwemo n`amafaranga agenerwa umwunganizi.
2. Mu bijyanye n'ikoreshwa ry'itegeko ryose
rijyanye no kurinda cyangwa kubahiriza
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge,
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisonera
gusa inzego za Leta n'abayobozi ku nshingano
zibasaba gufata ibyemezo bikosora byo kubona
umuti ukwiye mu gihe hari ibyakozwe cyangwa
bigiye gukorwa mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'iryo
tegeko.

articles.heading: Imiburanishirize y`imanza z`ubutegetsi Mu gihe icyemezo gikosora mu bijyanye n`imbonezamubano gishobora gufatwa nk'igisubizo
articles.text:
ku birebana n'ikibazo ku miburanishirize y`imanza
z`ubutegetsi mu mizi, iyo miburanishirize ikurikiza
amahame ahwanye n'ibivugwa muri iki Cyiciro.
ICYICIRO CYA 3:
IBYEMEZO BY'AGATEGANYO

articles.heading: 1. Inkiko zishobora gufata ibyemezo by'agateganyo byihuse kandi bihamye
articles.text:
a) bigamije gukumira ko habaho ukutubahiriza
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge,
ndetse by'umwihariko no gukumira ko hinjira mu
bucuruzi ibicuruzwa biri mu bubasha bwazo,
harimo n'ibitumizwa mu mahanga ako kanya
nyuma yo kubikura muri gasutamo;
b) bigamije gusigasira ibimenyetso by`ingenzi
birebana n`uko kutubahiriza uburenganzira.
2. Inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gufata ibyemezo
by'agateganyo bitabaye ngombwa ko undi
muburanyi yumvwa aho bikwiye, by'umwihariko
aho ubucyererwe bushobora kwangiriza mu buryo
budasubirwaho nyir`uburenganzira, cyangwa ahari
ibizazane bigaragara byatera kwangirika
kw'ibimenyetso.
3. Inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gusaba usaba gutanga
ikimenyetso cyose gihari cyumvikana kugira ngo
zizere bihagije ko ari we nyir`uburenganzira, kandi
ko uburenganzira bwe bwabangamiwe cyangwa ko
uko kubangamira uburenganzira kugarije, ndetse no
gutegeka usaba gutanga ingwate cyangwa ubundi
bwishingire bihwanye bihagije hagamijwe kurinda
uregwa no gukumira kurengera.
4. Aho ibyemezo by'agateganyo byafashwe undi
muburanyi atabanje kumvwa, ababuranyi
barameyeshwa, nta gucyererwa nyuma yo gushyira
mu bikorwa ibyo byemezo.
kongera gusuzuma, harimo n'uburenganzira bwo
kumvwa, bikorwa bisabwe n'uregwa kugira ngo
hafatwe icyemezo, mu gihe kitarambiranye nyuma
yo kumenyeshwa ibyemezo, niba bishobora
guhindurwa, gukurwaho cyangwa kwemezwa.
5. Usaba ashobora gusabwa gutanga andi makuru
ya ngombwa agaragaza ibicuruzwa birebwa
n'urwego ruzashyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo
by’agateganyo.
6. Bitabangamiye igika cya 4, ibyemezo
by'agateganyo byafashwe hashingiwe ku gika cya
mbere no ku cya 2, bisabwe n'uregwa, bikurwaho
cyangwa se bikareka kugira agaciro, iyo ibikorwa
biganisha ku cyemezo cy`urubanza mu mizi
bitatangiye mu gihe kitarambiranye kigenwa
n'urukiko rufata ibyemezo iyo amategeko y'Igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano abyemera cyangwa, mu
gihe nta cyagenwe, mu gihe kitarenga iminsi 20
y'akazi cyangwa iminsi 31 ku ngengabihe isanzwe
iyo icyo gihe ari kirekire.
7. Aho ibyemezo by'agateganyo byakuweho
cyangwa se aho byarekeye aho gukoreshwa bitewe
n'igikorwa cyose cy`usaba cyangwa n`icyo
yagombaga gukora atakoze, cyangwa se aho
bigaragaye nyuma ko hatabayeho kubangamira
cyangwa ibizazane byo kubangamira
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge,
Inkiko zifite ububasha bwo gutegeka usaba,
bisabwe n'uregwa, guha uregwa indishyi ikwiye ku
cyangijwe n`ibyo byemezo.
8. Iyo icyemezo cy'agateganyo gifashwe
nk'igisubizo cy'imiburanishirize y`imanza
z`ubutegetsi, iyo miburanishirize ikurikiza
amahame ahwanye n'ibivugwa muri iki Cyiciro.
ICYICIRO CYA 4:
IBISABWA BYIHARIYE BYEREKERANYE
N’IBYEMEZO BIKURIKIZWA KU MUPAKA

articles.heading: Guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ry`ibicuruzwa bikozwe n'ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, bikurikije
articles.text:
ibiteganywa byavuzwe haruguru, bishyiraho
uburyo butuma nyir`uburenganzira, ufite impamvu
zumvikana zo gukeka ko gutumiza mu mahanga
ibicuruzwa biriho ibirango by'ibyiganano cyangwa
ibicuruzwa byiganwe bibangamira uburenganzira
bw'umuhanzi bishobora kubaho, asaba mu
nyandiko, inzego z'ubutegetsi cyangwa inkiko
zibifitiye ububasha, guhagarika ikwirakwizwa
ry`ibyo bicuruzwa bikozwe n'ubuyobozi bwa
gasutamo.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
kwemera ko ubwo busabe bukorwa ku bijyanye
n`ibicuruzwa bituma habaho ukundi kubangamira
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge,
ibisabwa muri iki Cyiciro bipfa gusa kubahirizwa.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
kandi guteganya uburyo bukurikizwa n'ubuyobozi
bwa gasutamo mu guhagarika ikwirakwizwa
ry`ibicuruzwa bibangamira uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by`ubwenge bigenewe
koherezwa mu mahanga bivuye ku butaka bwabyo.

articles.heading: Ubusabe Nyir`uburenganzira wese utangiye uburyo buvugwa mu ngingo ya 51 asabwa gutanga ibimenyetso bikwiye byemeza inzego zibifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha ko, hashingiwe ku mategeko y'Igihugu
gitumiza mu mahanga, hariho mbere na mbere
kubangamira uburenganzira bwe ku mutungo bwite
mu by’ubwenge, ndetse no gutanga ku buryo
buhagije ibiranga ibicuruzwa kugira ngo abakozi
ba gasutamo bashobore kubimenya mu buryo
bworoshye.
Inzego zibifitiye ububasha zimenyesha usaba mu
gihe kitarambiranye iyo zemeye ubusabe bwe
cyangwa se iyo zitarabwemeye ndetse, aho izo
nzego ari zo zibigena, n`igihe zizafatiramo
ibyemezo.

articles.heading: Ingwate cyangwa ubundi bwishingire bihwanye Inzego zibifitiye ububasha zifite ubushobozi bwo
articles.text:
gusaba usaba gutanga ingwate cyangwa ubundi
bwishingire bihwanye bihagije mu kurinda uregwa
n'inzego zibifitiye ububasha no gukumira
kurengera.
Iyo ngwate cyangwa ubwo bwishingire bihwanye
ntibigomba kubangamira kwiyambaza ubu buryo.
Iyo, hagendewe ku busabe bwakozwe hakurikijwe
iki Cyiciro, ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo bwahagaritse
ikwirakwizwa ry`ibicuruzwa birimo ibishushanyo
cyangwa ibyitegererezo byo mu rwego rw’inganda,
impamyabuvumbuzi ibishushanyo ndangamiterere
cyangwa amakuru atashyizwe ahagaragara
bushingiye ku cyemezo kindi kitari icy'urukiko
cyangwa icy`urundi rwego rwigenga, kandi igihe
giteganywa mu ngingo ya 55 cyarangiye urwego
rubifitiye ububasha rudafashe icyemezo
cy'agateganyo, kandi haseguriwe ko ibindi bisabwa
byose bijyanye no gutumiza ibicuruzwa mu
mahanga byujujwe, nyirabyo, uwabitumije mu
mahanga cyangwa uwo bigenewe afite
uburenganzira bwo kubikwirakwiza habanje
gutangwa ingwate ihagije yo kurinda
nyir`uburenganzira ibangamirwa ryabwo ryose.
Kwishyura iyo ngwate ntibibangamira icyemezo na
kimwe mu bindi byemezo bikosora
nyir`uburenganzira ashobora guhabwa,
byumvikane ko ingwate isubizwa igihe
nyir`uburenganzira ananiwe kubahiriza
uburenganzira bwo kuregera urukiko mu gihe
kitarambiranye.

articles.heading: Kumenyeshwa ihagarikwa Utumiza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga n'ubisaba bamenyeshwa vuba ihagarikwa ry`ikwirakwizwa
articles.text:
ry`ibicuruzwa ryategetswe hagendewe ku ngingo
ya 51.

articles.heading: Igihe ihagarikwa rimara Iyo, mu gihe kitarenga iminsi 10 y'akazi nyuma y'igihe usaba yamenyesherejwe ihagarikwa,
articles.text:
ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo butamenyeshejwe ko
ibikorwa biganisha ku mwanzuro ku bijyanye
n'ikirego byatangijwe n'umuburanyi utari uregwa,
cyangwa urwego rubifitiye ububasha rwafashe
ibyemezo by'agateganyo byongera ihagarikwa
ry'ikwirakwizwa ry`ibicuruzwa, ibyo bicuruzwa
bishobora kurekurwa, haseguriwe ko ibindi
bisabwa byose mu gutumiza no mu kohereza
ibicuruzwa mu mahanga byujujwe; mu bihe
bikwiye, icyo gihe giteganyijwe gishobora
kongerwaho indi minsi yindi 10 y'akazi.
Iyo uburyo buganisha ku cyemezo mu mizi
y`urubanza bwatangijwe, kongera gusuzuma,
harimo uburenganzira bwo kumvwa, bikorwa
bisabwe n'uwarezwe hagamijwe kwemeza, mu gihe
kitarambiranye, niba ibyo byemezo bihindurwa,
bikurwaho cyangwa byemezwa.
Haseguriwe ibyavuzwe haruguru, aho guhagarika
ikwirakwizwa ry`ibicuruzwa bikorwa cyangwa
bikomeje hakurikijwe icyemezo cy'urukiko
cy'agateganyo, ibiteganywa n'igika cya 6 cy'ingingo
ya 50 birakurikizwa.

articles.heading: Gutanga indishyi k'Utumiza mu mahanga n`ukwa nyir'ibicuruzwa Inzego zibifitiye ububasha zifite ubushobozi bwo
articles.text:
gutegeka usaba kwishyura utumiza ibicuruzwa mu
mahanga, uwo bigenewe na nyirabyo indishyi
ikwiye ku ihungabanywa ryose bitewe n`ifungwa
ritemewe ry'ibicuruzwa byakwirakwijwe
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 55.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku Igenzura no ku Makuru Bitabangamiye kurinda amakuru y’ibanga, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, bigenera
articles.text:
ubushobozi urwego rubifitiye ububasha, bwo guha
ufite uburenganzira uburyo buhagije bwo
kugenzura ibicuruzwa byose byafashwe na
gasutamo mu rwego rwo kugaragaza ishingiro
ry'ibirego bye.
Inzego zibifitiye ububasha zifite kandi ubushobozi
bwo guha utumiza ibyo bicuruzwa mu mahanga
uburyo buhuye n'ubwo, bwo kubigenzuza byose.
Igihe icyemezo mu mizi y`urubanza cyafashwe,
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biha inzego
zibifitiye ububasha, ububasha bwo kumenyesha
ufite uburenganzira ku mazina na aderesi
y`uwohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga,
iby`ubitumiza mu mahanga n'iby`uwo bigenewe
ndetse n'ingano y' ibyo bicuruzwa.

articles.heading: Ibigomba gukorwa nta mpaka Iyo Ibihugu Bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisaba inzego zibifitiye ububasha gukora ku bushake
articles.text:
bwazo no guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa
bikeka ko bibangamira uburenganzira ku mutungo
bwite mu by’ubwenge:
a) inzego zibifitiye ububasha zishobora igihe icyo
ari cyo cyose gushaka amakuru kuri
nyir’uburenganzira ashobora kuzifasha mu
gushyira mu bikorwa ubwo bubasha;
b) utumiza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga na
nyir’uburenganzira bamenyeshwa byihuse
ihagarikwa.
Iyo utumiza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga yatanze
ubujurire ku ihagarikwa mu nzego zibifitiye
ububasha, ihagarikwa rigengwa n'ibisabwa
bivugwa mu ngingo ya 55 hahindurwa ibigomba
guhindurwa;
c) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisonera
gusa inzego n’abakozi ba Leta kuryozwa ibyemezo
bikosora bikwiye bafashe iyo byakozwe nta
buriganya cyangwa se batagambiriye uburiganya.

articles.heading: Ibyemezo bikosora Hatabangamiwe ubundi burenganzira nyir’uburenganzira afite bwo gutanga ikirego kandi
articles.text:
haseguriwe uburenganzira bw'uwarezwe bwo
gusaba kongera gusuzuma bikozwe n'urukiko,
inzego zibifitiye ububasha zifite ububasha bwo
gutegeka gusenya cyangwa gukura mu mucuruzi
ibicuruzwa bibangamira uburenganzira
hakurikijwe amahame ari mu ngingo ya 46.
Ku bijyanye n'ibicuruzwa bifite ibirango
by'ibyiganano, inzego zibifitiye ububasha
ntizemera kongera kubyohereza bimeze gutyo
cyangwa kubinyuza muri gasutamo ku bundi buryo,
usibye igihe hari impamvu zihariye

articles.heading: Ibyerekeye ibicuruzwa byinjizwa ari bike cyane Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisonera
articles.text:
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ingingo zibanza
ibicuruzwa bifite ingano nto bitagenewe gushyirwa
ku isoko, biri mu mitwaro bwite y’abagenzi
cyangwa byoherejwe ari bike cyane.
ICYICIRO CYA 5:
IMIBURANISHIRIZE Y`IMANZA
Z`INSHINJABYAHA

articles.heading: Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biteganya imiburanishirize y'imanza z`inshinjabyaha n'ibihano bitangwa nibura igihe hari ibikorwa byo
articles.text:
kwigana ikirango cy`uruganda cyangwa ibikorwa
byo kwigana bibangamira uburenganzira
bw`umuhanzi bikozwe mu rwego rw'ubucuruzi.
Ibihano birimo igifungo n'ihazabu cyangwa kimwe
muri byo bihagije mu gutanga isomo, kandi
bikwiranye n’urwego rw’ibihano bitangwa ku
byaha bifite uburemere bungana.
Mu buryo bukwiye, ibihano bifatwa bibamo kandi
ifatira, ubunyagwe n`iyangiza by`ibicuruzwa
bibangamira uburenganzira n' ibikoresho byose
byakoreshejwe mu ikorwa ry'icyaha.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biteganya
imiburanishirize y'imanza z`inshinjabyaha
n'ibihano bitangwa igihe hari ibindi bikorwa
bibangamira uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge, cyane cyane igihe bikozwe ku
bushake cyangwa mu rwego rw'ubucuruzi.
IGICE CYA IV
KUBONA NO KUBUNGABUNGA
UBURENGANZIRA KU MUTUNGO BWITE
MU BY'UBWENGE N'UBURYO BUJYANYE
NA BYO BUKURIKIZWA HAGATI
Y’ABABURANYI

articles.heading: 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora gusaba, nk'igisabwa mu kubona cyangwa mu kubungabunga uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite
articles.text:
mu by’ubwenge buvugwa mu icyiciro cya 2 kugeza
ku cya 6 by'igice cya II, kubahiriza uburyo
n’ibisabwa biboneye.
Ubwo buryo n`ibyo bisabwa bigomba kuba bihuye
n’ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano.
2. Iyo kubona uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge bishingira ko ubwo burenganzira
bwatanzwe cyangwa bwandikishijwe, Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikora ku buryo
uburyo bw`itanga n`ubw`iyandikisha, haseguriwe
ko ibisabwa by'ingenzi mu kubona uburenganzira
byubahirizwa, byemerera itangwa cyangwa
iyandikisha ry`uburenganzira mu gihe
kitarambiranye kugira ngo hirindwe kugabanya mu
buryo budasobanutse igihe cyo ku burengera.
3. Ingingo ya 4 y'Amasezerano y`i Parisi (1967)
ikurikizwa, hahindurwa ibigomba guhindurwa, ku
birango bya serivisi.
4. Uburyo bukurikizwa mu kubona cyangwa mu
kubungabunga uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite
mu by’ubwenge ndetse, n'aho amategeko y`Igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano ategenya ubwo buryo,
iseswa ry'ibyemezo by'ubutegetsi n’uburyo
bukurikizwa hagati y'ababuranyi nko
gusubirishamo urubanza, kurusesa no kurukuraho
bugengwa n'amahame rusange avugwa mu gika cya
2 no mu cya 3 by'ingingo ya 41.
5. Ibyemezo bya burundu by`ubutegetsi mu buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose mu buvugwa mu gika cya 4
bishobora kongera gusuzumwa n'urukiko cyangwa
n`urwego rwenda gusa na rwo.
Icyakora, ntihashobora kubaho inshingano yo
guteganya uburyo bwo kongera gusuzuma
ibyemezo ku birebana no gusubirishamo urubanza
cyangwa n`iseswa ry`ibyemezo by`ubutegetsi,
igihe cyose impamvu z'ubwo buryo zishobora kuba
uburyo bwo gutesha agaciro.
IGICE CYA V
GUKUMIRA NO GUKEMURA
AMAKIMBIRANE

articles.heading: Gukorera mu mucyo Amategeko n'amabwiriza ndetse n'ibyemezo bya burundu by’inkiko hamwe n'iby'ubutegetsi
articles.text:
byashyizwe mu bikorwa n'Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano ku bijyanye n'ibigegwa nayo (uko
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by`ubwenge
bubaho, ibigegwa na bwo, uburyo bwo kububona,
iyubahirizwa ryabwo ndetse n’ikumira
ry’ikoreshwa nabi ryabwo) bigomba gutangazwa,
cyangwa aho uko gutangazwa mu ruhame
bidashoboka, bigashyirwa aho abaturage babibona,
mu rurimi rw'Igihugu, mu rwego rwo guha Leta na
ba nyir`uburenganzira uburyo bwo kubimenya.
Amasezerano yerekeye ibirebwa n'aya Masezerano
akurikizwa hagati ya Leta cyangwa y`ikigo cya
Leta y'Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano na Leta
cyangwa n`ikigo cya Leta y'ikindi Gihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano na yo agomba gutangazwa.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bimenyesha Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo
Bwite mu by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi
amategeko n'amabwiriza avugwa mu gika cya
mbere mu rwego rwo gufasha iyo nama mu kongera
gusuzuma imikorere y'aya Masezerano.
Inama igabanya umutwaro ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry`iyi nshingano rishyira ku Bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano kandi ishobora gufata icyemezo
cyo gukuraho inshingano yo kuyimenyesha ako
kanya ayo mategeko n'ayo mabwiriza iyo
ubujyanama n'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga
ushinzwe kurengera Umutungo bwite mu
by’Ubwenge, ku ishyirwaho ry'igitabo kimwe
gikubiyemo ayo mategeko n`ayo mabwiriza
bwabyaye umusaruro.
Inama isuzuma kandi igikorwa cyose cyasabwa
kirebana no kumenyesha hakurikijwe inshingano
ziteganywa n'aya Masezerano zivuye mu
biteganywa n'ingingo ya 6 ter y'Amasezerano y`i
Parisi (1967).
3. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kigomba
kuba cyiteguye guha ikindi Gihugu biyahuriyeho
kibisabye mu nyandiko, amakuru y'ubwoko
buvugwa mu gika cya mbere.
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gifite impamvu
yo kwemera ko icyemezo cyihariye cy'urukiko
cyangwa icy'ubutegetsi cyangwa amasezerano
ahuriweho n'Ibihugu bibiri mu bijyanye
n'uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
gifite ingaruka ku burenganzira bwacyo
hakurikijwe aya Masezerano, gishobora na none
gusaba mu nyandiko guhabwa uburyo bwo kugera
ku makuru cyangwa se ubwo kumenyeshwa
birambuye ibijyanye n'icyo cyemezo cyihariye
cy'urukiko cyangwa icy'ubutegetsi cyangwa
amasezerano ahuriweho n'Ibihugu bibiri.
4. Nta na kimwe mu biteganywa mu gika cya
mbere, mu cya 2, no mu cya 3 gisaba Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano gutangaza amakuru
y'ibanga, itangazwa ryayo rishobora kuzitira
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'amategeko cyangwa rikaba
ritandukanye n'inyungu rusange cyangwa se rikaba
ryabangamira inyungu z`ubucuruzi zemewe
n`amategeko z`ibigo bya Leta cyangwa
iz`ibyigenga.

articles.heading: Gukemura amakimbirane 1. Ibiteganywa n'ingingo za XXII na XXIII z’Amasezerano Rusange ku Biciro n'Ubucuruzi yo
articles.text:
mu 1994 nk'uko biteganywa kandi bishyirwa mu
bikorwa n'Amasezerano y'ubwumvikane mu
gukemura amakimbirane, bikoreshwa mu
bujyanama no mu gukemura amakimbirane mu
rwego rw`aya Masezerano usibye aho biteganywa
ukundi muri aya Masezerano.
2. Uduka twa 1(b) na 1(c) tw'igingo XXIII
z'Amasezerano Rusange ku Biciro n'Ubucuruzi yo
mu 1994 ntizikoreshwa mu gukemura
amakimbirane muri aya Masezerano mu gihe cy
'imyaka itanu kuva ku itariki Amasezerano
y'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Bucuruzi
yatangiriye gukurikizwa.
3. Mu gihe kivugwa mu gika cya 2, Inama ku
Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu by’Ubwenge
Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi isuzuma ibirebwa
n`ibirego bivugwa mu duka 1(b) na 1(c) tw'ingingo
XXIII z'Amasezerano Rusange ku Biciro
n'Ubucuruzi yo mu 1994 yakozwe hakurikijwe aya
Masezerano n`uburyo bwo kubitanga, kandi
igatanga ibyifuzonama byayo mu Nama
y’abaminisitiri kugira ngo ibyemeze.
Icyemezo cyose cy'Inama y’abaminisitiri cyemeza
ibyo byifuzonama cyangwa cyongera igihe
kivugwa mu gika cya 2 gifatwa gusa ku
bwumvikane, kandi ibyifuzonama byemejwe
bikurikizwa ku Bihugu byose bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano hatabayeho ubundi buryo bwo
kubyemeza nyuma.
IGICE CYA VI
INGINGO Z'INZIBACYUHO

articles.heading: Ingingo z'inzibacyuho 1. Hagendewe ku biteganywa n'igika cya 2, icya 3 n'icya 4, nta Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gitegetswe kubahiriza ibiteganywa na yo mbere
y'irangira ry'igihe cy'umwaka umwe ukurikira
itariki Amasezerano y'Umuryango
Mpuzamahanaga w'Ubucuruzi yatangiriyeho
gukurikizwa.
2. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kiri mu nzira
y'amajyambere cyemerewe kwigiza inyuma ho
igihe cy`imyaka ine itariki y`iyubahirizwa, nk'uko
bisobanurwa mu gika cya mbere, ry'ibiteganywa
n'aya Masezerano, bitari ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya
3, mu ya 4 no mu ya 5.
3. Ikindi Gihugu cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano
kiri mu nzira y'ihinduranya kiva muri gahunda
y’ubukungu buteganyijwe kigana ku bukungu
bw’isoko bushingiye ku nganda, kandi cyatangiye
gukora impinduka z’imiterere y’umutungo bwite
wacyo mu by’ubwenge ndetse gifite ibibazo
byihariye mu itegurwa no mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’amategeko n’iry`amabwiriza ajyanye
n’umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge, kigira na none
igihe cyo kwigiza inyuma ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry`aya Masezerano nk’uko biteganywa mu gika cya
2.
4. Iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kiri mu
nzira y'amajyambere gifite inshingano, hakurikijwe
aya Masezerano, yo kurengera impamyabuvumbuzi
ku byatunganyijwe kugeza no mu
by'ikoranabuhanga bitarengerwa ku butaka bwacyo
ku itariki rusange y'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya
Masezerano kuri icyo Gihugu, nk'uko bisobanurwa
mu gika cya 2, icyo Gihugu gishobora gucyereza
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'ibiteganyijwe, mu bijyanye
n'impamyabuvumbuzi ku byatunganyijwe, mu
cyiciro cya 5 cy'igice cya II kuri ibyo bijyanye
n'ikoranabuhanga mu gihe cy'inyongera cy'imyaka
itanu.
5. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyifashisha
ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya mbere, mu cya 2, mu cya
3 cyangwa mu cya 4 kugira ngo kigire igihe
cy’inzibacyuho, gikora ku buryo impinduka zose
zakozwe muri icyo gihe mu mategeko, mu
mabwiriza no mu migirire byacyo zidatuma habaho
kudahuza kwabyo n'ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikennye Hibanzwe ku bikenewe no ku bisabwa byihariye by'Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikennye,
articles.text:
ku mbogamizi zabyo mu rwego rw`ubukungu, mu
rw`imari no mu rw'ubutegetsi, n'uko bikeneye
koroherezwa kugira ngo bigire ikoranabuhanga
ry'ibanze rizima, ibyo Bihugu ntibitegetswe
gushyira mu bikorwa ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano, usibye ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 3,
mu ya 4 no mu ya 5, mu gihe cy'imyaka 10 kuva ku
itariki y'ishyirwa mu bikorwa nk'uko iteganywa mu
gaka ka mbere k'ingingo ya 65.
Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi, binyuze mu
busabe bufite impamvu bw'Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gikennye, yemera kongera icyo gihe.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byateye
imbere bishyigikira ibigo n'inzego biri ku butaka
bwabyo hagamijwe guteza imbere no
gushishikariza ihererekanya ry`ikoranabuhanga mu
Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikennye
kugira ngo bifashwe kugira ikoranabuhanga
ry'ibanze rizima kandi rikora.

articles.heading: y'aya Masezerano, burimo no gufatanya n'imiryango bireba ihuza Ibihugu
articles.text:
6. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemera
ubushake bwo guteza imbere ihererekanya ry`
ikoranabuhanga n`ubwo kubaka ubushobozi mu
bijyanye n'imiti mu rwego rwo kurenga ikibazo
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byahuye na
cyo cyo kugira ubushobozi budahagije cyangwa
icyo kutagira na bucye mu bijyanye n`imiti.
Ku bw`ibyo, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bifite uburenganzira bwo gutumiza ibintu mu
mahanga n'Ibihugu byohereza ibintu mu mahanga
bishishikarizwa gukoresha uburyo buteganywa mu
buryo bworoshya kugera kuri iyi ntego.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeza
gufatanya mu buryo budasanzwe mu kwita ku
bijyanye no gutanga ikoranabuhanga ndetse no
kongera ubushobozi mu bijyanye n'imiti mu kazi
kagomba gukorwa hakurikijwe ingingo ya 66.2
y'aya Masezerano, igika cya 7 cy'Itangazo ku
Masezerano ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite
mu by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi
n'ubuzima bw`abaturage n'undi murimo wose wa
ngombwa w’Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo
Bwite mu by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi.
7. Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi yongera
gusuzuma buri mwaka imikorere y'uburyo kugira
ngo habeho imikorere ihamye yayo kandi buri
mwaka igashyikiriza Inama Rusange raporo ku
mikorere yayo.
UMUGEREKA W'AMASEZERANO KU
BURENGANZIRA KU MUTUNGO BWITE
MU BY’UBWENGE UKORERWAHO
UBUCURUZI
Isuzuma ry'ubushobozi bwo gukora imiti.
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikennye
bizwiho kugira ubushobozi budahagije cyangwa
butanahari bwo gukora imiti.
Ku bindi Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byemerewe gutumiza ibintu mu mahanga,
ubushobozi budahagije cyangwa butanahari bwo
gukora ibyo bintu bushobora kugaragarira mu
buryo bumwe muri ubu bukurikira:
i) Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kivugwa
cyagaragaje ko kidafite ubushobozi bwo gukora
imiti; cyangwa.
aho Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gifite
ubushobozi bwo gukora imiti, cyasuzumye ubwo
bushobozi kandi cyabonye ko, gukuraho
ubushobozi ubwo ari bwo bwose bufitwe cyangwa
bugenzurwa na nyir'impamyabuvumbuzi
bidahagije muri ako kanya.
Iyo bigaragaye ko ubwo bushobozi noneho
buhagije mu gusubiza ibyifuzo by`Igihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano, uburyo ntibwongera gukoreshwa.

articles.heading: Inama ku birebana n`Uburenganzira ku Mutungo bwite mu by’Ubwenge ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
articles.text:
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi ikurikirana
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya Masezerano, kandi
by'umwihariko, ikagenzura niba Ibihugu
biyahuriyeho byubahiriza inshingano
ziyateganywamo, kandi igaha ibyo Bihugu uburyo
bwo kujya inama ku bibazo bijyanye
n`uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
ukorerwaho ubucuruzi.
Ikora izindi nshingano nk'izo ihawe n'Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, kandi,
by'umwihariko, itanga ubufasha bwose bwasabwe
na byo mu rwego rwo gukemura amakimbirane.
Mu gushyira mu bikorwa inshingano zayo, Inama
ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi igisha inama
kandi igashaka amakuru aho ari ho hose yumva ari
ngombwa.
Ibigiyemo inama n'Umuryango Mpuzamahanga
ushinzwe kurengera Umutungo bwite mu
by'Ubwenge, Inama ishyiraho, mu gihe cy'umwaka
umwe nyuma y`inama yayo ya mbere, uburyo
bukwiye bw'ubufatanye mu nzego z'uwo
Muryango.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye mpuzamahanga Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemera gufatanya mu rwego rwo gukuraho ubucuruzi
articles.text:
mpuzamahanga bw`ibicuruzwa bibangamira
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge.
Ku bw`ibyo, bishyiraho amahuriro mu butegetsi
bwabyo, bikiyemeza guhanahana amakuru ku
bucuruzi bw’ibyo bicuruzwa.
Bigomba, by'umwihariko, guteza imbere
ihanahana ry'amakuru n'ubufatanye hagati
y`ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo ku birebana
n'ubucuruzi bw`ibicuruzwa bifite ibirango
by`inganda by'ibyiganano ndetse n'ibicuruzwa
byiganwe bibangamira uburenganzira
bw'umuhanzi.

articles.heading: Kurengera ibihangano bisanzwe biriho 1. Aya Amasezerano ntashyira inshingano mu bijyanye n'ibikorwa byakozwe mbere y'itariki
articles.text:
y'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'Amasezerano ku Gihugu
bireba.
2. Usibye aho biteganywa ukundi muri aya
Masezerano, aya Masezerano ashyiraho inshingano
mu bijyanye n`ibihangano bisanzwe biriho ku
itariki y'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo ku Gihugu
kiyarimo bireba, kandi ibyo bihangano
birengerwamo kuri iyo tariki, cyangwa byujuje
cyangwa se bizuzuza nyuma ibigenderwaho mu
kubirengera bivugwa muri aya Masezerano.
Ku bijyanye n'iki Gika ndetse n'igika cya 3 n'icya 4,
inshingano zerekeranye n`uburenganzira
bw`umuhanzi ku bihangano bisanzweho zigenwa
gusa n'ingingo ya 18 y'Amasezerano y`i Berine
(1971), kandi inshingano zerekeranye
n'uburenganzira bw`abakora za fonogaramu
n'ubw`abahanzi baririmba cyangwa bakina za
fonogaramu zisanzweho zigenwa gusa hakurikijwe

articles.heading: Isuzumwa n’amavugururwa Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo bwite mu by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi igomba
articles.text:
kongera gusuzuma ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya
Masezerano nyuma y'irangira ry'igihe
cy'inzibacyuho kivugwa mu gika cya 2 cy'ingingo
ya 65.
Inama, igendeye ku burambe yaboneye mu ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry’Amasezerano, igomba kongera
kuyasuzuma nyuma y`imyaka ibiri uhereye kuri iyo
tariki, na buri gihe nk`icyo nyuma yaho.
Inama ishobora kandi kongera gusuzuma yisunze
iterambere rishya ryose rishobora gusobanura
ihindurwa cyangwa ivugururwa ry'aya Masezerano.
2. Amavugururwa agamije gusa kuzamura urwego
rwo kurengera uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge bwatanzwe, kandi bukoreshwa,
hashingiwe ku yandi masezerano hagati y'Ibihugu
byinshi kandi yemewe n'Ibihugu byose bigize
Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w'Ubucuruzi,
ashobora kohererezwa Inama y’abaminisitiri kugira
ngo iyafateho ibyemezo biteganyijwe mu gika cya
6 cy'ingingo ya X y'Amasezerano y'Umuryango
Mpuzamahanga w'Ubucuruzi igendeye ku cyifuzo
cy'Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi.

articles.heading: Ukwifata Ukwifata ntigukorwa ku bijyanye n`ibitegenywa n'aya Masezerano ibyo ari byo byose Ibihugu
articles.text: biyahuriyeho bitabyemeye.

articles.heading: Amarengayobora ku mutekano Nta giteganyijwe na kimwe muri aya Masezerano gifatwa nko
articles.text:
a) gushyira ku Gihugu kiyarimo inshingano yo
gutanga amakuru kibona ko ishyirwa ahagaragara
ryaba rinyuranye n'inyungu z'ingenzi ku mutekano
wacyo; cyangwa
b) kurinda Igihugu kiyarimo gufata icyemezo icyo
ari cyo cyose icyo Gihugu kibona ko ari ngombwa
mu kurengera inyungu z’ingenzi ku mutekano
wacyo:
i) birebana n’ibikoresho by’ingufu za kirimbuzi
biturika cyangwa ibikoresho byifashishwa mu
ikorwa ryabyo;
ii) birebana n’ubucuruzi bw’intwaro, ubw`amasasu
n’ubw`ibikoresho by’intambara n`ubucuruzi bwose
bw’ibicuruzwa n’ubw`ibikoresho bigenewe mu
buryo buziguye cyangwa butaziguye kugemurira
inkambi ya gisirikare;
iii) bikoreshwa mu bihe by'intambara cyangwa mu
bindi bihe by`imidugararo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga; cyangwa
c) kubuza Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gufata
ibyemezo mu gushyira mu bikorwa inshingano
zacyo hakurikijwe Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
ashyiraho Umuryango w'Abibumbye mu
kubungabunga amahoro n'umutekano
mpuzamahanga.
UMUGEREKA W'AMASEZERANO KU
BURENGANZIRA KU MUTUNGO BWITE
MU BY’UBWENGE UKORERWAHO
UBUCURUZI
1. Ku birebana n'ingingo ya 31bis n'uyu mugereka:
a) "imiti" bivuga icyakozwe cyose gifite
impamyabuvumbuzi, cyangwa icyakozwe
cyatunganyijwe hifashishijwe uburyo
bw'Impamyabuvumbuzi, yo mu rwego rw'imiti
kugira ngo hakemurwe ibibazo by'ubuzima
bw`abaturage nk'uko bivugwa mu gika cya mbere
cy'Amasezerano ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo
Bwite mu by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi
n'ubuzima bw’abaturage (WT/MIN(01)/DEC/2).
Byumvikana ko harimo ibikenewe bya ngombwa
mu ikorwa ryayo ndetse n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma
bya ngombwa mu ikoreshwa ryayo.
b) "Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gifite
uburenganzira bwo gutumiza ibintu mu mahanga"
bivuga Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gikennye,
n'ikindi Gihugu cyose kiyarimo cyamenyesheje
Inama ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi ubushake
bwacyo bwo gukoresha uburyo buvugwa mu
ngingo ya 31bis ("uburyo") nk'igitumiza ibintu mu
mahanga, byumvikana ko Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gishobora kumenyesha igihe icyo ari
cyo cyose ko kizakoresha uburyo uko bwakabaye
cyangwa mu buryo budasesuye, nk`urugero gusa
mu mategeko yo mu bihe by`imidugararo ku rwego
rw`Igihugu cyangwa mu bindi bihe bidasanzwe
cyangwa se mu gihe cy’ikoreshwa ridasanzwe mu
bifitiye inyungu rubanda mu bikorwa bitari
iby’ubucuruzi.
Byumvikane ko Ibihugu bimwe bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bidakoresha uburyo buvugwa
nk`Ibihugu biyahuriyeho bitumiza ibintu mu
mahanga kandi ko ibindi Bihugu biyahuriyeho
byatangaje ko, bikoresheje ubwo buryo byaba gusa
mu bihe by`imidugararo ku rwego rw`Igihugu
cyangwa mu bindi bihe byihutirwa cyane;
c) "Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyohereza
ibintu mu mahanga" bivuga Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gikoresha uburyo kugira ngo
gitunganye imiti bisabwe n`Igihugu biyahuriyeho
gifite uburenganzira bwo kuyitumiza mu mahanga,
ndetse kiyohereze muri icyo Gihugu cyayitumije
mu mahanga.
2. Uburyo buvugwa mu gika cya mbere cy'ingingo
ya 31bis buteganya ko:
a) Igihugu cyangwa Ibihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano bifite uburenganzira bwo gutumiza
ibintu mu mahanga byahaye imenyesha Inama ku
Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu by’Ubwenge
Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi:
i) rigaragaza amazina n'ingano y'ibyakozwe
bikenewe bitegerejwe;
ii) ryemeza ko Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gifite uburenganzira bwo gutumiza ibintu mu
mahanga kivugwa, kitari Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gikennye, cyagaragaje ko gifite
ubushobozi budahagije cyangwa ko nta na bucye
gifite mu bijyanye no gukora imiti ivugwa muri
bumwe mu buryo buri ku Kagereka k’Umugereka
w’aya Masezerano; kandi
ryemeza ko, aho umuti watangiwe
impamyabuvumbuzi ku butaka bwacyo, cyatanze
cyangwa giteganya gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 31 n`iya 31bis z'aya
Masezerano n'ibiteganywa n'uyu Mugereka;
b) uruhushya rutegetswe rwatanzwe n'Igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano cyohereza ibintu mu mahanga
hakurikijwe uburyo ruba rurimo ibisabwa
bikurikira:
i) ingano ya ngombwa ikenewe gusa n’Igihugu
cyangwa n`Ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano bifite
uburenganzira bwo gutumiza ibintu mu mahanga
ishobora gukorwa hagendewe ku ruhushya ndetse
n’ingano yose y’ibyo bicuruzwa ijyanwa mu
Gihugu cyangwa mu Bihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano byamenyesheje Inama ibyo bikeneye
ku Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu
by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi;
ii) ibicuruzwa byakozwe hakurikijwe uruhushya
bigaragazwa ku buryo bugaragara
n`akarangagicuruzwa cyangwa n`ikimenyetso
cyihariye nk’ibyakozwe hakurikijwe uburyo.
Abatanga ibicuruzwa bagomba kubitandukanya
binyuze mu kubipfunyika mu buryo bwihariye no
kubiha amabara ari mu buryo budasanzwe cyangwa
kimwe muri byo, iryo tandukanya ripfa gusa kuba
rishobora gukorwa kandi ridafite ingaruka igaragara
ku giciro; kandi
iii) mbere yo gutangira kohereza, ufite uruhushya
ashyira ku rubuga rw`ikoranabuhanga amakuru
akurikira:
- ingano yoherezwa buri hantu nk’uko bigaragazwa
mu gaka ka (i) haruguru,
- n’ibiranga igicuruzwa cyangwa ibicuruzwa
bibitandukanya n`ibindi nk`uko bivugwa mu gika
cya (ii) haruguru;
c) Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyohereza
ibintu mu mahanga kimenyesha Inama ku
Burenganzira ku Mutungo Bwite mu by’Ubwenge
Ukorerwaho Ubucuruzi, iby’itangwa
ry’uruhushya, harimo n’ibisabwa bigendana na
rwo. Amakuru atangwa aba arimo izina ry’ufite
uruhushya n’aderesi ye, igicuruzwa cyangwa
ibicuruzwa byatangiwe uruhushya, ingano
y’ibyatangiwe uruhushya, Ibihugu igicuruzwa
cyangwa ibicuruzwa bigomba gutangwamo n’igihe
uruhushya ruzamara.
Imenyesha rigaragaza na none aho urubuga
rw`ikoranabuhanga rwavuzwe mu gaka (b) (iii)
haruguru rubarizwa.
3. Mu rwego rwo kwiringira ko ibicuruzwa
byatumijwe muri ubwo buryo bikoreshwa ibyo
byatumirijwe bijyanye n’ubuzima rusange, Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemerewe gutumiza
ibintu mu mahanga bifata mu buryo bwabyo
ingamba zikwiye zihuye n’uburyo bwabyo
bw’imiyoborere n’ingaruka zo kuyobya ubucuruzi
mu rwego rwo kwirinda kongera kohereza mu
mahanga ibicuruzwa byatumijwe ku butaka bwabyo
muri ubwo buryo.
Igihe igihugu cyemerewe gutumiza ibintu mu
mahanga ari Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kiri
mu nzira y’amajyambere cyangwa gikennye gifite
imbogamizi mu gushyira mu bikorwa iyi ngingo,
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byateye
imbere, bibisabwe mu gihe no mu buryo
byemeranyijweho, biteganya ubufatanye mu bya
tekiniki no mu by’imari mu rwego rwo koroshya
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.
4. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikora ku
buryo habaho uburyo bwemewe n'amategeko
bukoreshwa mu gukumira gutumiza mu mahanga
no kugurishiriza ku butaka bwabyo ibicuruzwa
byakozwe muri ubwo buryo kandi bikayoberezwa
ku masoko yabyo mu buryo butajyanye n'ibyo
biteganya, hakoreshejwe uburyo busabwa kuba
buhari hakurikijwe aya Masezerano.
Iyo Igihugu cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano kibona
ko izo ngamba kuri icyo kibazo zidahagije, ikibazo
cyongera gusuzumwa mu Nama ku Burenganzira
ku Mutungo Bwite mu by’Ubwenge Ukorerwaho
Ubucuruzi bisabwe n'icyo Gihugu.
5. Hagamijwe kubyaza umusaruro ubukungu mu
rwego rwo kuzamura ubushobozi bwo kugura ku
bijyanye n’imiti, n`urwo koroshya itunganyirizwa
ryabyo mu Gihugu, bizwi ko ishyirwaho ry'uburyo
buteganya itangwa ry’impamyabuvumbuzi zo mu
karere zigomba gukoreshwa mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano bivugwa mu gika cya 3
cy'ingingo ya 31bis rigomba gutezwa imbere.
Ku bw`ibyo, Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byiyemeza ubufatanye mu bya tekiniki hakurikijwe
